findings.description:
Reentrancy in TradeEscrow.fund(bytes32) (src/TradeEscrow.sol#92-102):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- token.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender,address(this),amount) (src/TradeEscrow.sol#99)
	Balance read before the call:
	- beforeBalance = token.balanceOf(address(this)) (src/TradeEscrow.sol#98)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- token.balanceOf(address(this)) - beforeBalance != amount (src/TradeEscrow.sol#100)
		- stale variable `beforeBalance`

TradeEscrow.openDispute(bytes32) (src/TradeEscrow.sol#139-153) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- state == State.Inspecting && block.timestamp >= inspectUntil (src/TradeEscrow.sol#144)
	- block.timestamp < deliveryBy (src/TradeEscrow.sol#148)

TradeEscrow.releaseAfterInspection() (src/TradeEscrow.sol#124-128) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp < inspectUntil (src/TradeEscrow.sol#126)

TradeEscrow.constructor(TradeEscrow.Terms) (src/TradeEscrow.sol#64-78) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- t.fundBy <= block.timestamp || t.fundBy > block.timestamp + 604800 || t.dispatchWindow < 86400 || t.dispatchWindow > 2592000 || t.deliveryWindow < 86400 || t.deliveryWindow > 5184000 || (t.inspectionWindow != 86400 && t.inspectionWindow != 172800 && t.inspectionWindow != 259200) (src/TradeEscrow.sol#66)

TradeEscrow.acceptTerms(bytes32) (src/TradeEscrow.sol#79-85) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp >= fundBy (src/TradeEscrow.sol#81)

TradeEscrow.refundUndispatched() (src/TradeEscrow.sol#129-133) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp < dispatchBy (src/TradeEscrow.sol#131)

TradeEscrow.fund(bytes32) (src/TradeEscrow.sol#92-102) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp >= fundBy (src/TradeEscrow.sol#94)

TradeEscrow.markDispatched(bytes32) (src/TradeEscrow.sol#104-112) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp >= dispatchBy (src/TradeEscrow.sol#106)

2 different versions of Solidity are used:

		-^0.8.20 (node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/interfaces/draft-IERC6093.sol#3)
		-^0.8.20 (node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol#4)
		-^0.8.20 (node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol#4)
		-^0.8.20 (node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/extensions/IERC20Metadata.sol#4)

		-^0.8.20 (node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Address.sol#4)
